REQUEST_PRINCIPAL_CONTRACT.binding: FROZEN. This is the semantic core of S3.
REQUEST_PRINCIPAL_CONTRACT.assertion_not_grant: selectedOrganizationId is an ASSERTION from the carrier, NEVER an authorization grant. A cookie naming an organization the subject was removed from five minutes ago is perfectly authentic and must still be refused.
REQUEST_PRINCIPAL_CONTRACT.authoritative_rederivation: The authoritative membership MUST be re-derived on EVERY REQUEST by the triple (userId, selectedOrganizationId, status='active'). Not once per session, not once per login, not from a durable cache.
REQUEST_PRINCIPAL_CONTRACT.indistinguishability_requirement: A DELETED or NONEXISTENT selected organization MUST be indistinguishable from NON-MEMBERSHIP at this boundary. Both yield TENANCY_SELECTED_ORGANIZATION_NOT_A_MEMBER. Distinguishing them turns the boundary into an existence oracle for organization ids the subject has no right to probe.

NO_FALLBACK.binding: On refusal there is NO fallback of any kind. Each item below is independently prohibited.
prohibited_fallbacks: an organization inferred from the route
an organization inferred from the project or any other addressed resource
NO_FALLBACK.single_membership_is_not_an_exception: Even when the subject holds exactly ONE active membership, an absent or non-matching selection is a REFUSAL, not an inference. SESSION_SCOPE.no_selection_behavior already forbids that inference for the carrier WRITE; this extends the same rule to the principal READ.

REQUEST_PRINCIPAL_CONTRACT.SUPERSEDES_PICK_FIRST: The existing pick-first shape - `userId + status='active' + limit(1)` at lib/auth/database-context.ts loadActiveMembershipWithinContext - is SUPERSEDED. This is the SI-2 site.

PROHIBITED_IMPLEMENTATION_SHAPE.shape: Select one UNQUALIFIED membership with .limit(1), THEN compare the result against selectedOrganizationId.
PROHIBITED_IMPLEMENTATION_SHAPE.why_it_is_prohibited: It is observationally correct for a single-membership subject and CATASTROPHICALLY wrong the moment S7 lands: with two active memberships the unqualified limit(1) returns an ARBITRARY row, so a subject legitimately selecting organization B is refused whenever the database happens to return A. It converts a correct selection into a refusal non-deterministically, and it does so silently.
PROHIBITED_IMPLEMENTATION_SHAPE.REQUIRED_SHAPE: The selected organization MUST be part of the MEMBERSHIP PREDICATE ITSELF - a single qualified lookup on (user_id, organization_id, status='active'). organization_members_org_user_unique guarantees that predicate addresses at most one row.
PROHIBITED_IMPLEMENTATION_SHAPE.control: MS3-9 exists precisely to catch the prohibited shape, and is LOAD-BEARING.

REQUEST_PRINCIPAL_SHAPE.binding: FROZEN. The conceptual principal, field by field.
REQUEST_PRINCIPAL_SHAPE.user: AUTHORITATIVE. From the verified auth subject and the readable public.users row, unchanged by S3.
REQUEST_PRINCIPAL_SHAPE.selectedOrganizationId: ASSERTION ONLY. Carries no authority of its own.
REQUEST_PRINCIPAL_SHAPE.membership: AUTHORITATIVE, derived from the SELECTED pair (userId, selectedOrganizationId, status='active').
REQUEST_PRINCIPAL_SHAPE.organization: DERIVED from the validated membership. Never read ahead of, or independently of, that validation.
REQUEST_PRINCIPAL_SHAPE.role: DERIVED SOLELY from the selected membership. There is no other role source.
REQUEST_PRINCIPAL_SHAPE.isSuperAdmin: AUTHORITATIVE, revalidated by the EXISTING mechanism - read from public.users under the subject's own claims and re-checked against public.current_user_is_super_admin() inside db/identity-context.ts. S3 does not widen, narrow or relocate this.
REQUEST_PRINCIPAL_SHAPE.carrier_shape_validation_is_not_authoriz: The UUID-shape check in lib/auth/selected-organization.ts rejects MALFORMED values. Passing it means the value is well-formed, never that it is permitted. Treating shape validation as an authorization step is the confused-deputy failure this clause exists to name.

SELECTOR_DECIRCULARISATION.the_circularity: The organization-selection page CANNOT require the selected-org principal in order to let the user select an organization. After S3, getCurrentOrganizationContext() resolves through the SELECTED pair - so on the selector page, where no selection exists yet, it necessarily returns null. A selector that renders from the request principal would show 'you belong to no organization' to every user who has not yet selected one, and there would be no way to ever select.
SELECTOR_DECIRCULARISATION.resolution: S3 MUST expose a SELECTABLE-MEMBERSHIPS ENUMERATOR that is SEPARATE from the request principal: it answers 'which organizations may this subject select', keyed on (userId, status='active') alone, and it performs NO selection and grants NO authority.
SELECTOR_DECIRCULARISATION.enumerator_is_not_a_principal: BINDING. The enumerator returns CANDIDATES for an explicit human act. It must never be consumed to construct a principal, a role, an RLS predicate or a GUC, and it must never auto-select - not even when it returns exactly one row.

NO_NEW_LIB_AUTH_MODULE.binding: PROHIBITED. The enumerator MUST be hosted and exported from an EXISTING context module - `@/lib/auth/session` or `@/lib/auth/database-context`. Creating e.g. lib/auth/memberships.ts is a STOP.
NO_NEW_LIB_AUTH_MODULE.MEASURED_MECHANISM: MEASURED FROM THE SCANNER'S OWN CODE at INTEGRATION_SHA, not asserted. tests/database-runtime-entrypoints.test.ts:305 declares CONTEXT_MODULES = ['@/lib/auth/session', '@/lib/auth/database-context', '@/db/identity-context'], and databaseSymbols() SKIPS any import whose specifier is in that list ('Modules that are the ANSWER, not the risk'). The selector page currently passes the per-file assertion for a SUBTLE reason: requireAuth and getCurrentOrganizationContext are NOT in CONTEXT_OPENERS, so opensAContext(page.tsx) is FALSE - the page survives ONLY because both symbols arrive from @/lib/auth/session, which is skipped, leaving databaseSymbols EMPTY and usesDatabase() false.
NO_NEW_LIB_AUTH_MODULE.WHAT_A_NEW_MODULE_WOULD_DO: If the enumerator lived in lib/auth/memberships.ts, the page's import of it would NOT be skipped; that module reaches db/client.ts, so its exported symbol would enter databaseSymbols; the page's render region calls it, so usesDatabase() becomes TRUE; and because opensAContext(page.tsx) is FALSE, the per-file assertion FAILS. The only two remedies are to add the page to ALLOWLIST (moving the pinned magnitude allowlisted 16 -> 17) or to add the new module to CONTEXT_MODULES/contextModulePaths - and BOTH edit tests/database-runtime-entrypoints.test.ts, which is OUTSIDE the S3 ceiling. The AST layer forces the same conclusion through tests/database-entrypoint-inventory.json, also outside the ceiling.
NO_NEW_LIB_AUTH_MODULE.therefore: The prohibition is MECHANICALLY LOAD-BEARING, not stylistic: hosting the enumerator inside an existing CONTEXT_MODULE keeps the specifier skipped and moves NO ledger, which is exactly why the 12-path ceiling can promise GOVERNANCE_LEDGER_STABILITY.
NO_NEW_LIB_AUTH_MODULE.honest_scope_of_the_measurement: RECORDED FOR PRECISION. The pinned tuple's `inventoried` and `reaching` fields are app/-scoped (ENTRY_POINTS = walk(APP)), and the AST inventory holds ZERO lib/ rows, so a new lib/auth module would not by itself add an inventory ROW. The forced delta comes from the SELECTOR PAGE's classification flipping, not from the new module being counted - which is why `allowlisted` is the magnitude that would actually move. Stating the mechanism this precisely is what lets a future auditor falsify it.

SELECTOR_DECIRCULARISATION.selector_must_work_with_no_selection: The selector route must render correctly when the carrier is ABSENT, when it is MALFORMED, and when it names an organization the subject is no longer a member of. In all three cases it presents the selectable set and no error state that blocks selection.

INERTNESS_RETIREMENT.binding: NS2-4 is RETIRED BY REPLACEMENT, NEVER SILENTLY DELETED. Deleting the old inertness assertion without installing the replacement S3 assertion in the same change is a FAILURE, and MS3-10 exists to catch exactly that.
INERTNESS_RETIREMENT.what_changes: After S3, lib/auth/database-context.ts MUST consume the selected-org carrier. NS2-4's current form asserts that FIVE canonical surfaces - db/identity-context.ts, lib/auth/database-context.ts, lib/auth/session.ts, lib/auth/permissions.ts, lib/auth/roles.ts - neither import lib/auth/selected-organization nor reference the carrier cookie name. That assertion becomes false for database-context.ts BY DESIGN, and for session.ts only to the extent the enumerator/principal wiring requires.

what_MUST_STILL_HOLD.binding: The retirement is NARROW. These three surfaces MUST STILL NOT consume the carrier DIRECTLY.
what_MUST_STILL_HOLD.why_db_identity_context_stays_out: It is the MECHANISM. It must receive an organization id that has ALREADY been validated by the principal layer; reading the cookie itself would let it construct its own claim and would bypass the very revalidation S3 exists to add.

INERTNESS_RETIREMENT.leaf_rule: lib/auth/selected-organization.ts REMAINS A LEAF. It imports no authorization surface.

import_direction.why: A cycle here would let the carrier module reach the principal it is an input to, and would make the leaf's 'this module consumes nothing' guarantee unenforceable.

INERTNESS_RETIREMENT.REPLACEMENT_ASSERTION_REQUIRED: The S3 replacement MUST assert, at minimum: (a) the three surfaces above still do not import lib/auth/selected-organization nor reference the cookie-name literal; (b) lib/auth/selected-organization.ts imports no authorization surface, preserving the leaf and the import direction; (c) the carrier is consumed by database-context ONLY through the revalidating principal path, never as a direct authorization input. An S3 candidate in which NS2-4 is gone and no such assertion exists is a STOP.
INERTNESS_RETIREMENT.header_must_be_rewritten_not_left_stale: lib/auth/selected-organization.ts's module header currently states that wiring it into database-context 'performs S3 without S3's revalidation lineage and is exactly the failure tests/tenancy/s2-selected-org-carrier.test.ts exists to catch.' After S3 that sentence is FALSE. Leaving it in place would leave the repository asserting a prohibition it no longer enforces.

SECURITY_INVARIANTS.binding: FROZEN AND ENFORCEABLE. Each invariant must be observable by at least one control in TEST_CONTRACT.
SECURITY_INVARIANTS.cookie_tampering: A carrier edited to name another organization is well-formed and MUST still be refused. Shape validation is not authorization.
SECURITY_INVARIANTS.stale_or_revoked_membership: Revocation is effective on the NEXT REQUEST, with no grace window. A membership revoked mid-session must not survive in any memo, cache or closure.
SECURITY_INVARIANTS.IDOR_cross_org_principal_mismatch: A selected organization the subject is not an active member of can never become the request's organization context.
SECURITY_INVARIANTS.confused_deputy: No server-side component may treat the carrier as having been validated by someone else. The revalidation is performed by the principal layer on every request, not assumed from the fact that a cookie exists.
SECURITY_INVARIANTS.superadmin_leakage: Super-admin status is never derived from, widened by, or granted through the carrier. The existing double check - public.users under own claims, then current_user_is_super_admin() - is preserved unchanged.
SECURITY_INVARIANTS.role_escalation: The role comes ONLY from the selected membership. No route, project, resource or carrier value may supply or raise it.
SECURITY_INVARIANTS.permission_cache_staleness: Per-request memoisation is permitted; cross-request persistence of the membership proof is PROHIBITED. M-3 governs this.
SECURITY_INVARIANTS.request_context_bleed: One request's principal must never be observable from another. AsyncLocalStorage isolation and SET LOCAL transaction-locality are PRESERVED; set_config's third argument stays true. M-2 governs the GUC locality.
SECURITY_INVARIANTS.server_side_cookie_trust: No server component may trust the carrier's value for any decision other than 'which organization to attempt to revalidate'.
SECURITY_INVARIANTS.direct_db_bypass: Direct database access without an identity context remains FAIL-CLOSED - as uellix_app a claimless query returns zero rows rather than erroring, so the fail-closed property must be preserved rather than assumed.
SECURITY_INVARIANTS.no_module_level_auth_state: No module-level mutable auth state may be introduced. A module-scoped principal would leak across requests in a warm server process.

TEST_CONTRACT.binding_by_id_not_restatement: The batch manifest docs/ops/tenancy/MULTI_ORG_TENANT_SCOPE_TEST_MANIFEST_v1.0.0.json ALREADY governs S3 and is bound HERE BY ID. It is NOT restated, NOT forked and NOT superseded. Creating a competing S3-specific manifest is a STOP.

INHERITED_IDS.P-4: S3 / MO-03 + MO-05. The request principal resolves the membership by the (user, SELECTED organization) pair rather than pick-first.
INHERITED_IDS.P-5: S3 / MO-06. The role used for every capability check is the role held in the SELECTED organization's membership. STRUCTURAL coverage only in S3 - see P5_COVERAGE.
INHERITED_IDS.N-1: SC-1 / S3. A carrier naming an organization in which the subject holds no ACTIVE membership is REFUSED.
INHERITED_IDS.N-2: SC-2 / S3. Membership revoked mid-session is refused on the NEXT request, with no grace window.
INHERITED_IDS.M-3: Mutation: memoize the membership proof for the life of the session. Must be caught.
INHERITED_IDS.M-4: Mutation: replace the TENANCY_SELECTED_ORGANIZATION_NOT_A_MEMBER refusal with a fallback. Must be caught.
INHERITED_IDS.M-8: Mutation: drop user_single_active_membership in any node earlier than S7. Must be caught. Inherited to PROTECT the S7 ordering that P5_COVERAGE depends on.

ADDED_S3_CONTROLS.S3-1: The membership is resolved by a SINGLE QUALIFIED predicate on (user_id, selected organization_id, status='active') - the selected organization is part of the predicate, not a post-filter.
ADDED_S3_CONTROLS.S3-2: No selected organization yields TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED, and no principal with an organization is constructed.
ADDED_S3_CONTROLS.S3-3: A selected organization with no active membership yields TENANCY_SELECTED_ORGANIZATION_NOT_A_MEMBER.
ADDED_S3_CONTROLS.S3-4: A DELETED or NONEXISTENT selected organization is INDISTINGUISHABLE from non-membership at this boundary - same code, same shape, no existence oracle.
ADDED_S3_CONTROLS.S3-5: No fallback occurs on refusal, INCLUDING when the subject holds exactly one active membership.
ADDED_S3_CONTROLS.S3-6: The role on the resulting principal comes solely from the selected membership, and isSuperAdmin is unchanged in derivation.
ADDED_S3_CONTROLS.S3-7: The selectable-memberships enumerator is exported from an EXISTING context module (@/lib/auth/session or @/lib/auth/database-context); NO new lib/auth/* module exists. Asserted structurally.
ADDED_S3_CONTROLS.S3-8: The selector route renders and permits selection with the carrier ABSENT, MALFORMED, and naming a non-member organization.

MUTATION_CONTROLS.MS3-1: Remove the selected-organization conjunct from the membership predicate. Expected: S3-1 and P-4 FAIL.
MUTATION_CONTROLS.MS3-2: Return the first active membership when the selected organization has none. Expected: S3-5, N-1 and M-4 FAIL.
MUTATION_CONTROLS.MS3-3: Cache the membership proof across requests. Expected: N-2 and M-3 FAIL.
MUTATION_CONTROLS.MS3-4: Distinguish 'organization does not exist' from 'not a member' by code or message. Expected: S3-4 FAILS.
MUTATION_CONTROLS.MS3-5: Derive the role from a route or resource parameter instead of the selected membership. Expected: S3-6 and P-5 FAIL.
MUTATION_CONTROLS.MS3-6: Grant super-admin from the carrier. Expected: S3-6 FAILS and the identity-context super-admin re-check refuses.
MUTATION_CONTROLS.MS3-7: Auto-select when the enumerator returns exactly one membership. Expected: S3-5 and S3-8 FAIL.
MUTATION_CONTROLS.MS3-8: Make set_config's third argument false so the GUC outlives the transaction. Expected: M-2 FAILS.
MUTATION_CONTROLS.MS3-9: LOAD-BEARING. KEEP the unqualified .limit(1) and filter the selected organization AFTERWARD. Expected: S3-1 FAILS. This mutation is observationally indistinguishable from correct behaviour for a single-membership subject, so a control that only exercises one membership CANNOT catch it - S3-1 must assert the PREDICATE SHAPE, not merely the returned row.
MUTATION_CONTROLS.MS3-10: LOAD-BEARING. DELETE assertion NS2-4 without installing the S3 replacement. Expected: the replacement's absence FAILS. A suite in which removing a control makes everything green is not a suite.
MUTATION_CONTROLS.MS3-11: Host the enumerator in a NEW lib/auth/* module. Expected: S3-7 FAILS. (Independently, the entrypoint gate would force an out-of-ceiling ledger edit - observing BOTH is the point.)
MUTATION_CONTROLS.MS3-12: Import lib/auth/database-context from lib/auth/selected-organization, inverting the import direction. Expected: the replacement leaf/direction assertion FAILS.
MUTATION_CONTROLS.MS3-13: Read the carrier directly inside db/identity-context.ts. Expected: the replacement assertion FAILS.

TEST_CONTRACT.NO_MUTATION_MAY_BE_DOCUMENTARY: BINDING. Every mutation above MUST be applied by the future implementing mission to ACTUAL WORKING-TREE BYTES, observed to produce a NAMED failure, and then REVERTED. A mutation control that is merely described in prose proves nothing. The implementing mission MUST record, per mutation, the exact file and the exact failing test name.
TEST_CONTRACT.mutation_harness_discipline: Mutations MUST be applied in CHUNKS with pristine copies taken BEFORE each chunk, and each touched file MUST be verified byte-identical after revert - never by a grep of occurrence counts. A harness killed mid-control otherwise leaves a mutation on disk.
TEST_CONTRACT.CRLF_HAZARD: MEASURED REPOSITORY HAZARD. .gitattributes pins docs/** to LF, but other text files round-trip through core.autocrlf. A mutation that searches for an LF newline in a CRLF file is a SILENT NO-OP and would be recorded as 'control passed' when nothing was mutated. Every mutation must be verified to have actually changed the bytes before its expected failure is credited.

REAL_PG_CONTRACT.binding: S3 uses the EXISTING live-runtime PostgreSQL host. Creating a disposable S3 PostgreSQL harness is a STOP - the two-tenant live-PG capability the S3 threat model needs already exists at that host, and a second harness would duplicate provisioning, double the flake surface and fork the fixture semantics.

controls.S3-PG-1: The membership resolved against a real cluster is the one belonging to the SELECTED organization - proven with the subject holding a membership and the selection naming it.
controls.S3-PG-2: A REVOKED selected membership is refused on the NEXT request against the real cluster, with no grace window and no surviving memo.
controls.S3-PG-3: A WRONG selected organization cannot become the database context: app.organization_id is never set to an organization the subject is not an active member of, and current_user_org_ids() refuses it at the identity probe.
